answer: Interleaved arrival gating: each identity must submit requests with a minimum gap drawn from a per-identity kernel delay and a slowly drifting offset, so a lone agent looks like a sparse sonnet of spaced beats while clones inherit overlapping timing. Enforcement rejects any burst whose gap variance falls below the delay floor. An attacker cloning N identities still pays N distinct enforced wait cycles, plus a real voyage of staggered scheduling to keep gaps plausible.
